To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) TCTL model checking can be solved in polynomial space; (2) TCTL model checkers can be implemented to use only linear space in the worst case, and (3) TCTL model-checking algorithms can be implemented to be on-the-fly, i.e., to explore only the portion the state space that is essential for determining satisfaction of a TCTL specification.
we developed a PSPACE model-checking algorithm that is on-the-fly and that is space-efficient.
